info.title: PriceLens API
info.description: Cross-platform price comparison API: one canonical product per item, with every store listing matched to it and its price history.

tags.name: affiliate
tags.description: Affiliate link tracking, store redirects and conversions

tags.name: api-keys
tags.description: Workspace API keys for the partner API

password.description: Min 8 chars, must contain letter and number

refreshToken.description: JWT refresh token. Omit in cookie mode: the pl_rt cookie is used.

canonicalProductId.description: The product to attach the listing to. Required to accept an item that proposed none.

platformSlugs.description: Store slugs to sweep; all enabled stores when omitted.

dryRun.description: Only log proposed merges. Defaults to RECONCILIATION_DRY_RUN.

thresholdValue.description:
A target price, an absolute drop, or a percentage, depending on
`alertType`. Ignored for RESTOCK, which fires on a stock transition.

repeatable.description: Re-arm after firing instead of parking in TRIGGERED.

cooldownHours.description: Minimum hours between notifications for a repeating alert.

platformId.description: The tracked store that is this seller's own, when we crawl it.

targetMarginPct.description: Percentages of price, not of cost.

providerKey.description: Which AffiliateProvider builds the links, e.g. "amazon".

trackingParams.description: Extra query parameters added to every outbound link.

immediately.description: Default is cancel-at-period-end; the user keeps what they paid for.

days.description: Overrides the plan's interval for hand-sold contracts.

limits.description: A PlanLimits object; validated by parsePlanLimits.

reference.description: The transfer reference printed on the wallet / InstaPay receipt.

payerAccount.description: The number or InstaPay address the money was sent from.

code.description: Empty for Telegram, where the code is sent to the bot rather than typed here.

categoryId.description: Omit (or null) for the store's default rule.

id.description: Made by the browser, so the duration beacon can name the view later.

durationMs.description: Time the page was visible, in ms. Sent more than once; the largest wins.

searchTotal.description: The result count a search page showed.
